windowTitle: Serial integration - Cloud Qualification green on canonical main
scope: Record that the OPL Cloud Qualification workflow, including its real Linux 'Test first Local application deployment with real owners' fabric job, passes on canonical main after the built-Agent regression fixes were merged.
context: The same workflow failed on main run 36644007785 (mutual-exclusion defect) and on branch run 36646236276 (dropped DataCompatibility in the recovered runtime command). Both were fixed and merged in PR #693.
This run proves the real first Local application deployment reaches ready, observes a real process failure back to the accepted order, and recovers, with the fixes in place.
notRun: Candidate build (owner-actor dispatch), Instance deployment, provider action, production readback.
Real route activation (I07), publisher opl-model-config/v1 readback (I08 serving half), typed Serve->Fabric application-execution boundary (I06).
claimBoundary: This receipt claims the Cloud Qualification workflow, including the real Linux first-Local-application-deployment job, passes on canonical main. It does not claim a Candidate image, Instance deployment or production acceptance.
